skills.name: Cola! Cola! Cola!
skills.description: Takes out a cola and drinks it, good effect on allies.  *HP +300% (7 sec) *Skill Evade Rate +30% (7 sec) *Evade Rate +30% (7 sec)

skills.name: Steam Gorilla
skills.description: Rides the Steam Gorilla and charges into enemies full force. Bad effects on enemies.  *Cancels enemy buffs   *Enemy Skill Resistance -50% (7 sec) *ATK x 3600% Area Damage

abilities.name: Group: Dr. STONE
abilities.description: Dr. STONE Tie-Up! Put Rangers of a group into a Team and HP buffs will be applied in battle. You must have a Team of at least 2 Rangers for group buffs to apply. The more Rangers you have in a Team from the same group, the stronger the buffs will be. (There are 5 buff levels.)

abilities.name: Deploy Knockback: Agility
abilities.description: Has a high chance of knocking back all Agility type enemies and canceling their invincibility skill effects when Rangers deploy. - Activates 5 seconds after battles start. - You must wait 6 seconds before you can use an Ability again after using one with the same effect on the same type of Ranger. - Bosses, Guardians, and special type enemies are not affected by this Ability.
